title: GPIO bank: 8 bidirectional pins with per-pin output enable and input readback
features: 8 bidirectional pins `gpio[7:0]`; each pin is driven from OUT only while its OE bit is 1, otherwise it is released (high impedance).
Input readback: IN shows the pin levels registered one clock earlier.
OUT reads back the value last written.
Interrupt HIGH is set while any registered input pin is high (level source, so it sets again until the pins are low).

fields.desc: 1: pin driven from OUT; 0: pin is an input

words.name: OUT
words.desc: Output values (driven on pins whose OE bit is set)

words.name: IN
words.desc: Pin levels, sampled one clock earlier

notes: gpio is the pin bank; it passes through unchanged.
